I asked an MLB player what he wishes he knew earlier about hitting.

“Feel-good BP is backwards. You’re wanting to feel good when it doesn’t matter and you have a false sense of 'being ready'"

"Get your routine in. Then challenge yourself in the box every single day."

"Nobody’s ever gotten a hit that counts in a cage."

"All those barrels off a 47 mph fastball stay there. What comes with you is how you trained your eyes, your decisions, and your path at game speed.”
